item.tib: spyi spungs skor gsum gyi yang bcud rtsod pa bzlog pa'i 'khor lo dbal gsas rngam pa'i las rim
item.coloph: 'di la shog ser dmar ser btub bcu gnyis pa kha thig mtshal du yod/ mtshal gyi spyan skor phreng bcu dgu yod pa las zhal bshus so/ sprul sku mnyam med dbyil ston gyi/ sa pho stag gi lo la rgyung srub brag nas ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad yos bu'i nyi ma la/ bon gyi dngos grub bsnyems nas 'gro don mdzad pa la/ dad 'dun mos pa'i byang chub sems bskyed nas/ 'gro don du 'phen (phan) bdag gis zhus so/ shog ser nyid las bshus shing gter dpe ji bzhin byas nas dag par bris//
